rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible blastocyst assessment with appropriate caveat about single-image uncertainty, but the exact 3BC/4BC call and TE/ICM grading cannot be verified here and some described detail may be somewhat inferential rather than clearly image-grounded.

Thoroughly integrates age, AMH, prior miscarriage, semen parameters, endometrium, diagnosis, and lifestyle with embryo morphology, correctly emphasizing age as a major favorable factor and low AMH as more relevant to quantity than quality.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, linking fair morphology with favorable patient factors to arrive at a moderate implantation estimate; only minor uncertainty comes from morphology-dependent probability calibration.

Recommendations are well aligned with standard IVF practice: SET in a 27-year-old, no routine PGT-A based on age alone, no unnecessary add-ons, and no full RPL workup after a single miscarriage unless losses recur.

Gives clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, cohort review, and reserve counseling; could be even more actionable with more explicit transfer-cycle contingencies or lab-specific decision points.
